# Crop Image

> > Free online image cropping tool supporting multiple formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP, SVG) with no registration required.

Crop Image is a browser-based image editing tool operated by Wruff GK, a Japan-based company. The platform provides privacy-focused image cropping capabilities across multiple languages and is part of a broader ecosystem of online utility tools.

## Key Topics

- Image Cropping
- JPEG
- PNG
- WebP
- SVG
- Free Tool
- No Registration
- Browser-Based
- Privacy-Focused
- Online Editor
- HEIC Support

- Japanese Company

- Image Formats

## Core Tool

- [Free Online Image Cropping (Traditional Chinese)](https://cropimage.com/zh-tw): Free online image cropping tool supporting JPEG, PNG, WebP, SVG formats
- [Free Online Image Cropping (Slovak)](https://cropimage.com/sk): Free online image cropping tool with no registration required
- [Free Online Image Cropping (Thai)](https://cropimage.com/th): Free online image cropping supporting JPEG, PNG and other formats
